pinyin: Qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià
english: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

pinyin: Xué ér shí xí zhī, bù yì yuè hū
english: Is it not a pleasure to learn and practice what you have learned?
Practice makes perfect.
Dripping water wears through stone — persistence prevails.
The slow bird flies early — compensate with extra effort.

pinyin: Huó dào lǎo, xué dào lǎo
english: Live until you are old, learn until you are old.

pinyin: Yǒu zhì zhě, shì jìng chéng
english: Where there's a will, there's a way.
Strive unceasingly to improve yourself.
Review the old to understand the new.
Mend the fold after losing the sheep — it is never too late to fix a mistake.

pinyin: Yī fēn gēng yún, yī fēn shōu huò
english: No pain, no gain — every bit of effort brings its reward.
Never yield despite countless setbacks.
Firm and unyielding in the face of difficulty.
Bear hardship and work hard without complaint.
Diligence can make up for a lack of natural talent.
Keep an open mind as vast as a valley.
There is no end to learning.
Read widely to broaden your knowledge.
Opening a book always brings benefit.

pinyin: Sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī
english: Among any three people walking, one can be my teacher.
Knowledge and action should be united.
Keep your feet on solid ground — be down-to-earth.

pinyin: Yī rì zhī jì zài yú chén
english: The plan for the day should be made in the morning.
Seize the moment and find joy in the present.
Contentment brings lasting happiness.
Find joy in a simple, virtuous life.
Take pleasure in doing good and helping others.
The benevolent love others.
The foolish old man moved mountains — perseverance conquers all.
The bird Jingwei filled the sea — never give up against impossible odds.
Grind an iron rod into a needle — patience and persistence pay off.
Ride the wind and cleave the waves — forge ahead boldly.
One cry startles everyone — achieve sudden remarkable success.
The latecomer surpasses the pioneer.
Green plums and bamboo horses — childhood friends who grow close.
Feel like old friends at the first meeting.
May all your heart's wishes come true.
Win instant success — may your endeavor succeed immediately.

pinyin: Gōng fu bù fù yǒu xīn rén
english: Hard work never betrays those who persevere.
Many little things add up to something great.

pinyin: Bù jī kuǐ bù, wú yǐ zhì qiān lǐ
english: Without accumulating small steps, you cannot reach a thousand miles.
Seek truth from facts — be practical and honest.
Win people over through virtue, not force.
Carve without giving up — keep going with tenacity.

pinyin: Bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
english: Seeing once is better than hearing a hundred times.
A famous teacher produces outstanding students.
Indigo blue comes from the plant but surpasses it — the student surpasses the master.
Repay resentment with kindness.

pinyin: Rén zhī chū, xìng běn shàn
english: At birth, human nature is fundamentally good.
Things of a kind gather together — like attracts like.
The sea accepts a hundred rivers — embrace diversity with an open heart.
Serve the country with utmost loyalty and dedication.

mandarin: 天行健，君子以自强不息
traditional: 天行健，君子以自強不息
pinyin: Tiān xíng jiàn, jūn zǐ yǐ zì qiáng bù xī
english: As heaven moves vigorously, the noble person strives without ceasing.

mandarin: 地势坤，君子以厚德载物
pinyin: Dì shì kūn, jūn zǐ yǐ hòu dé zài wù
english: As earth is receptive, the noble person carries all things with great virtue.
A long road reveals a horse's strength — time reveals true character.
Over time, a person's true heart is revealed.
Life is impermanent — cherish each moment.
Stand together through wind and rain — support each other in hard times.

pinyin: Tuán jié jiù shì lì liàng
english: Unity is strength.
